s: Paul thanks God for the Philippians. For me to live is Christ, and to die is gain.
Have the mind of Christ, who emptied himself and became obedient unto death, and God exalted him.
Paul counts everything as loss compared to knowing Christ.
Rejoice in the Lord always. I can do all things in him who strengthens me.

2: An early hymn about Christ, who was God and became a servant, obedient even to death on a cross, and so was exalted above all.

1: in the bowels of Jesus Christ
The bowels were thought of as the seat of feeling. Here: the heart, deep compassion.
In older English “conversation” meant way of life and conduct, not talk.
2: The bowels were thought of as the seat of feeling. Here: the heart, deep compassion.
“Solicitous” here means caring, concerned for others.
3: Here: citizenship, the community one belongs to.
